Pass 1 awarded COMPOUNDER_PASS after Q3 2026 delivered +1.8 pp volume/mix and +380 bps gross margin expansion. However, Pass 2 downgrades MDLZ to REJECTED (TIER_0, VALUATION) with NOT_HELD (0 shares) and 100% Treasury Cash.
